title: [PDF] Beta-glucan Content, Antioxidant and Antimicrobial Activities of Some Edible Mushroom Species | Semantic Scholar
abstract:
This review summarizes the latest findings on biological and health-promoting potential of mushroom beta-glucans for the treatment of civilization and viral diseases, with particular emphasis on COVID-19.Expand
The antimicrobial activity of acetone and methanol extracts of mushrooms showed varied levels of inhibitory effects on the microorganisms tested, and mushroom extracts had low reducing power capacity in comparison to standards. In this study the β-glucan content, antioxidant and antimicrobial activities of Boletus edulis, Cantharellus cibarius, Craterellus cornucopioides, Hydnum repandum and Agaricus bisporus were studied.
This review summarizes the latest findings on biological and health-promoting potential of mushroom beta-glucans for the treatment of civilization and viral diseases, with particular emphasis on COVID-19.Expand
The analysis of high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) as well as the result of fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) has confirmed the presence of $\beta$-glucans polysaccharide in the tested samples, which showed higher antioxidant activities when compared with standard antioxidant (Vitamin C).Expand
